namingRationale: 'Crest' evokes the apex of a form-finding process — a precision editorial system at its highest register. 'Form' grounds it in the geometric vocabulary of the assembled tokens: sharp corners, structured grids, display-scale typography. Together: architectural precision, editorial authority, white-field restraint.

color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modifications. color_register_actual: light (pageBackground #ffffff, luminance 255).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing injection at intensity 3 — added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em to cssVars, applied to all heading entries (h1, h2, link). Font replacements: Grotesk-Bold (proprietary) replaced with Clash Display (Google Fonts CDN, concept-matched: bold geometric editorial authority). Times (proprietary) replaced with EB Garamond (Google Fonts CDN, concept-matched: humanist serif for body warmth). Weight shifted from 400 to 700 on h1 and 600 on link to leverage Clash Display's distinctive bold widths.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist E: Delay introduction at intensity 3 — 0.1s stagger delay introduced between sequenced .animate-fade-in elements (4 nth-child entries: delays 0s, 0.1s, 0.2s, 0.3s). Added 0.1s delay on #email input transition. timingTokens.staggerDelay set to 0.1s. Existing durations and easing curves preserved from source.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Gap value scaling ×1.3 at intensity 2. All column and row gap values scaled from 16px to 21px (×1.3). At bp-700px: rowGap 16→21px, columnGap 56→73px. At bp-1000px: columnGap 4→5px. opal-grid-gap token and opal-grid-contain formula updated to use 21px. All layout structure unchanged.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Global scale factor ×1.35 at intensity 3. All numeric spacing values multiplied by 1.35. header marginRight/Left 62.0781→83.805px, nav padding 10→13.5px, button paddingTop/Bottom 15→20.25px, button paddingRight/Left 49.5→66.825px, borderRadius 3→4.05px, container paddingTop/Bottom 50→67.5px, container paddingRight/Left 185→249.75px, p marginBottom 17.64→23.814px.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E: Focus state enhancement at intensity 3 — added focus state with outlineWidth: 2px and outlineStyle: solid to all link and navigation link entries. Default and hover states preserved from source unchanged. No color values modified.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links at intensity 3 — added typography.letterSpacing: 0.08em. Geometry unchanged (height: 160, paddingInline: 8, fixed position). Scroll transition mechanism unchanged (none). characterDescription updated to reference the added letter spacing effect.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist B: Restraint shift — Section 5 (Background and Section Design Behavior) rewritten from analytical to purely observational register. Original interpretive claims removed; only what is visible is described, with no explanatory framing. concept_by_video.md generated with 3 video placements: hero-ambient.mp4 (10s, near-still editorial figure), brand-surface.mp4 (5s, macro material surface with light rake), editorial-still.mp4 (5s, room-interior ambient shadow movement).

checkA.notes: navText #000000 vs navBackground #ffffff (brightness 0 vs 255 — strong contrast). navTextScrolled #000000 vs navBackgroundScrolled #ffffff (same). bodyText #000000 vs pageBackground #ffffff (same). No mismatch.

checkB.notes: Interaction states use 'transition: all' with no explicit numeric duration. Motion primary duration is 0.6s. No numeric hover transition to compare — no mismatch possible.

checkC.notes: nav.json has no typography.fontFamily field — implicitly inherits from page. Assembled type-system provides Clash Display and EB Garamond via Google Fonts CDN. No unavailable font reference in nav.
